summary: RFID wristbands for hotels and resorts that combine guest identification, room access, cashless spending and activity management in one wearable credential.
Elastic band plus the soft TPU head fit with the wrist perfectly .
This wristband allows big antenna, so easily achieve good reading distance especially for DESFire series of products.
